unresolved: Survey local shore and terrain before refining the source polygon; lake levels vary and the mapped state is not permanent.
Qualify source-water rights, upland conveyance alignment, seasonal yield and basin hydrogeology; RIV-003 remains outside the city.
Measure lake and process chemistry, validate recoveries, isolate hazardous fractions and license final effluent loads.
Engineer finite next-cell storage, inventory legacy residues, fund closure and provide verified future capacity before making long-term service promises.
Map a real emergency buffer and operating reductions if terminal-lake discharge is unavailable; no hidden outlet is assumed.
Qualify agricultural land and water separately for residents and the additional Orison/Sola commitments; this is not total regional output.
Model power dispatch, fuel, storage losses, charging windows, transmission contingencies and treatment energy.
Design actual regional and local route alignments, dry-to-berth lake access, gradients and accessible alternatives.
Author a terminal-lake food web and dryland fauna compatible with salinity and substrates; do not import freshwater or estuarine taxa by default.
Resolve managed kettlebarrel introduction, husbandry permits and native fodder supply before treating Toc as a routine citywide practice.
Review the proposed local chronology and biographies for integration; no new local date is silently promoted to planet canon.
